correctness.rationale: For all n>=3 and strictly positive weights, every isometric embedding of the full 2^n weighted Hamming cube in the complex rectangular Schatten-1 class is classified. Equality in the top-to-bottom trace-norm triangle forces each vertex to lie in the positive cone U H_epsilon for the SAME polar partial isometry U, 0<=H_epsilon<=|A|. Singleton P_i=H_{e_i} have trace w_i and ||P_i-P_j||_1=w_i+w_j; the sign-duality equality condition forces mutually orthogonal supports. For each vertex epsilon and each active i, ||H_epsilon-P_i||_1=Tr(H_epsilon-P_i) yields H_epsilon>=P_i. Saturation of total trace over the mutually orthogonal supports leaves no off-support or off-diagonal mass; hence H_epsilon=sum_{i active}P_i. These disjoint positive blocks yield complex-linear extension L(z)=U sum z_i P_i with trace norm sum w_i|z_i|. Nonzero disjoint supports force rank(top-bottom)>=n and min(p,q)>=n, realized by diagonal constructions; at p=q=n all blocks rank one, giving the two-unitary normal form. Inspected `checker.py` generates higher-rank complex rectangular witnesses and exact diagonal metrics. Its 104261 reported diagnostics are not used to prove the universal rigidity.
